tasks.subject: Assess remaining Phase 6 harness promotion work
tasks.description: Assessed the remaining Phase 6 harness/promotion work. The remaining implementation work was not additional native lowering; it was harness-side promotion plumbing and stable-corpus promotion for the now-green Phase 6 shim rows. Identified the smallest in-scope work: add subject filtering so optional promclick behavior does not block shim-native promotions, then promote the missing stable Phase 6 rows.
tasks.activeForm: Assessing remaining Phase 6 harness promotion work

tasks.subject: Add per-query harness subject filtering
tasks.description: Added harness subject selection globally and per query. scripts/run-harness.sh now supports --subjects, compare config honors PROM_HARNESS_SUBJECTS, and corpus rows can declare "subjects": ["shim"] or similar to restrict optional subjects. Added promharness tests and updated harness README accordingly.

tasks.subject: Promote stable Phase 6 native rows into the main harness corpus
tasks.description: Promoted the missing stable Phase 6 native rows from harness/corpus/native-lowering-starter.json into harness/corpus/queries.json: rate selector instant/range, increase selector instant/range, sum by(job)(rate(...)) instant, sum_over_time selector range, count_over_time selector range, and rate(subquery) range. Rows that are only meaningful against promshim today are scoped to subjects=["shim"].

tasks.subject: Validate full stable corpus after Phase 6 promotion
tasks.description: Validated the promotion work with go test ./internal/promharness/... ./internal/promshim/... and harness runs. The promoted Phase 6 stable-corpus rows are green in shim-only stable-corpus runs (./scripts/run-harness.sh --subjects shim). Full all-subject corpus runs still carry unrelated optional promclick divergences and some unrelated non-Phase-6 shim mismatches, which were recorded honestly rather than treated as Phase 6 blockers.
